review_candidates.title: Workplace Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role The IT and AI Enablement function exists to make Legora itself run as well as the product we sell: secure, automated, and compounding over time. The Workplace Network Engineer owns the network and connectivity estate across every Legora location — the Meraki and Tailscale footprint, from wired and wireless to WAN and the zero-trust mesh — accountable for keeping every site fast, secure, and connected. You set the network standards the whole company is built to, and the Workplace Technology Leads at each site are your hands for installs and upgrades. What You'll Be Doing Own the reference design every site is rolled out from — LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN / SD-WAN, segmentation (VLANs), DNS / DHCP, and firewall policy — so each new office comes up the same proven way. Run the Meraki Dashboard as the single source of truth — configuration templates, firmware lifecycle, licensing and inventory, alerting, and capacity planning across all sites. Operate the Tailscale zero-trust mesh — ACLs, device posture, and access routing — alongside Information Security, who owns identity and the access policy itself. Monitor connectivity proactively and own uptime: catch degradation before users feel it, drive incidents to resolution, run root-cause analysis, and keep mean-time-to-recover falling. Plan and program-manage network installs and upgrades for new-site buildouts and refreshes — scope the design, order and stage hardware, and direct the on-site Workplace Technology Leads and cabling / ISP vendors who do the physical work, holding them to Legora’s acceptance tests. Manage ISP, circuit, and connectivity-vendor relationships — procurement, contracts, SLAs, and escalations — and forecast network spend with Finance. Partner with the IT Systems and Helpdesk teams on Tier-2 / Tier-3 network escalations, and document the estate so it stays legible to the rest of the function. Who You Are 6+ years in network engineering or network-focused IT infrastructure, including owning a multi-site corporate network end to end as the final escalation point — with no senior network engineer above you to hand it to. For the Staff end of the band, ~10+ years and a track record of defining network architecture across a multi-site organization. Deep Cisco Meraki experience at multi-site scale — and you understand what the Dashboard abstracts away. You can design and reason about the routing, segmentation, and RF beneath it, and keep the network running when the abstraction leaks. Fluency with the GUI is assumed, not the job. Vendor-agnostic command of network fundamentals — you design from first principles, not from templates: L2 / L3 boundaries, IP addressing and subnetting (IPAM), routing including BGP with ISPs, dual-circuit / SD-WAN failover, VLAN segmentation, DNS / DHCP, QoS, and firewall policy — and you troubleshoot at the packet level (e.g. Wireshark) when the dashboard isn’t enough. Able to walk us through a multi-site network you designed end to end — the trade-offs you made, a failure mode you engineered out, and a cutover or migration you ran without taking the business down. A standards-setter — you’d rather define one blueprint every site copies than improvise each office, and you keep the next buildout cleaner than the last. Automation-minded — you reach for the Meraki API, Pulumi or Terraform, and scripting to manage the network as code, rather than clicking through dashboards by hand. A calm operator under pressure — when a site drops, you’re methodical, communicative, and relentless about root cause, not just the quick fix. A program manager who delivers through others — comfortable owning timelines, vendors, and a budget, and getting work done through on-site teams you don’t directly manage. Nice To Have Cisco depth at CCNP / CCIE level — certified or demonstrably equivalent. CCNA alone is below the bar for this role; Meraki CMNA / ECMS a plus. Production experience operating Tailscale or comparable zero-trust network access (ZTNA), and certificate / mTLS fundamentals. Office buildouts and structured / low-voltage cabling — commissioning networked building systems and coordinating installers. Physical-security and AV networking — getting cameras / access-control (e.g. Verkada) and conferencing (Neat, Zoom) onto the network and keeping them available. Comfortable running work through an ITSM / service-desk platform and adopting AI-assisted, agentic automation — we run an AI-native ITSM (Serval). Connectivity and SaaS-reachability monitoring across sites — synthetic / path monitoring (e.g. ThousandEyes, Catchpoint), a multi-site NMS (e.g. Auvik, PRTG, or Datadog), and SNMP / syslog telemetry, on top of Meraki’s native alerting. Wi-Fi design and validation tooling — RF surveys and heat-mapping (e.g. Ekahau or Hamina). Experience with Meraki, Tailscale, Neat, Zoom, Verkada, Okta, and 1Password. Please note that due to summer holidays, our response times may be a little longer than usual. We'll be reviewing applications from late July/early August. Thank you for your patience! What’s In It For You Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America. Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success. Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily. In-person environment: Union Square office designed for ambitious builders and company provided lunch daily. Benefits & Perks: We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: Medical, Dental & Vision Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection) Dental plans via MetLife Vision plans via Vision Care Family Support Generous parental leave Free access to Maven Clinic Dependent Care FSA Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents Additional Perks Pre-tax commuter benefits Life Insurance + STD/LTD 401(K) with generous company match Unlimited PTO Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Compensation Range: $215K - $254K

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Austin, US Atlanta, GA Denver, CO Seattle, WA Applications will be accepted until November 01, 2026. About The Role Cloudflare operates one of the world's largest and most interconnected networks, spanning 335+ cities across every region of the globe. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Edge Network & Backbone team — someone who brings deep operational experience, an AI-first mindset, and the instinct to mentor and lift the engineers around them. In your first year, this role is deliberately hands-on: you'll be in the operational trenches, owning complex faults, driving capacity work, and setting the standard for how we run the network. Beyond that, you'll help shape how the team works — building AI-enabled tooling and agents that reduce toil, accelerate troubleshooting, and make the whole team more effective. This is a North American based role, but you'll be joining one global team: the sun never sets on Cloudflare, and our engineers hand off work across every time zone to keep the network running around the clock. Responsibilities Own the technical operation, engineering, and architecture of Cloudflare's global network, including planning, installation, and day-to-day management of hardware and software across the edge and backbone. Serve as a hands-on operational anchor for the team — diagnosing and resolving complex network faults, owning incident response end-to-end including on-call rotation, and contributing to post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement. Build production AI agents for network operations. Design, ship, and own LLM-powered tools that integrate with our operational systems of record via tool calling. Ship them with evals, observability of agent decisions, cost tracking, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where autonomous action carries blast radius. Apply AI to accelerate troubleshooting. Use and extend our internal AI platform (Workers AI, AI Gateway) to speed up root cause analysis, pattern recognition across faults, and operational decision-making under pressure. Architect network improvements that lower latency, reduce packet loss, and increase scale — optimising end user experience across Cloudflare's global infrastructure. Mentor and develop junior engineers on the team, setting technical standards, conducting structured troubleshooting sessions, and building a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning. Collaborate with internal teams on cross-functional network projects, contributing to design documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles that outlast any individual contributor. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience Proven track record in large-scale network engineering and operations. Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript and/or Go sufficient to build, debug, and maintain agent code, not just to glue scripts together. Working knowledge of agent integration patterns: function/tool calling, MCP or equivalent, retrieval over operational corpora (runbooks, postmortems, change history), and prompt iteration with evals. Experience reasoning about agent failure modes in production: hallucination guards, fallback paths, rollback, blast-radius control. Deep expertise in BGP and anycast routing, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex routing issues in a production environment. Strong understanding of MPLS and Segment Routing. Proficiency across multiple network vendor operating systems (Juniper, Cisco, Arista, or similar). Experience with network automation frameworks such as SaltStack, Ansible, or equivalent, and a strong instinct for solving operational problems through code. Ability to prioritise effectively and lead calmly when faced with high-pressure scenarios. An effective communicator who can adapt their style to any audience — whether guiding a junior engineer through a fault or presenting a network architecture decision to senior leadership. Bonus Points Shipped LLM-powered tooling into production use by a team other than your own, with measurable operational impact. Professional-level network certification (JNCIP, CCNP, or equivalent or higher). Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM and DWDM. Linux system administration. Experience writing network configuration and design documentation at an architectural level. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000 Washington, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $237,000. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. review_candidates.description: Department: Technology Location: Chicago, IL Description The network team designs, implements, and supports the network infrastructure for Wolverine's proprietary real-time trading systems, including proprietary hardware platforms, with a focus on low latency. Network performance and redundancy are critical to the global trading operation. The Network Engineer will be part of a team that works with Wolverine's software engineers and traders to support the high availability of the electronic trading infrastructure. This is a hybrid position, with a mixture of working from home and working in our Chicago office. The candidate is expected to be local to the Metropolitan Chicago area and will periodically travel to Chicago and New Jersey area data centers. What You’ll Do Design, engineer, and implement low-latency network solutions based on requirements from business stakeholders Own and manage strategic projects to implement and optimize low-latency, high-performance network solutions at and between data center locations Work with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks to implement network connectivity in shared colocation facilities Carry out high-level analysis and troubleshooting of the network infrastructure Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate, and resolve complex problems, ensuring timely results and minimal disruption to operations Perform network maintenance and system upgrades, including patches and hotfixes to address vendor bugs and vulnerabilities Monitor system resource utilization and historical trends, and perform capacity planning Provide the technical knowledge needed to ensure safe, effective, and efficient changes to the network infrastructure Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation Participate in the team's on-call rotation What We’re Looking For Minimum of 6 years in a technical networking environment as a network engineer Deep, hands-on experience with complex network designs and principles, including L2 switching and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) in complex environments, with advanced traffic steering, filtering, and route redistribution Strong network security fundamentals: firewalling (ASA, Palo Alto), security zones and DMZ design, network ACLs, NAT, and site-to-site IPSec VPN Solid knowledge of multicast (PIM, IGMP) and best practices for deploying it, including the delivery of real-time market data feeds Extensive knowledge of network operating systems (IOS / NX-OS / EOS / PANOS based network devices) Ability to troubleshoot network latency and packet-drop issues using monitoring, diagnostic, and packet analysis tools (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark) Meticulous attention to detail, with a proven ability to prioritize competing workloads and manage implementation schedules Strong cross-functional collaboration and the ability to work independently within a team structure Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex technical issues into clear, concise terms Strategic thinking balanced with sharp day-to-day execution, and a commitment to continuous improvement Preferred CCIE certification Knowledge of exchange connectivity in financial trading environments Experience working with financial exchanges, brokers, and banks Experience with network automation; understanding of Python and Ansible Experience with physical planning, implementing, and supporting space, power, and structured cabling within a data center environment Experience troubleshooting fiber optic connectivity within and between data center locations Bonus Points Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP) Understanding of network time synchronization protocols Experience with databases and big data tools (e.g., MySQL, Splunk, InfluxDB, Grafana) Experience with Linux shell utilities We strive to be the experts of our own network, and this role is expected to operate with that mindset - including the willingness to invest the time needed to learn our environment in depth, and the humility to own and learn from mistakes. We are currently only considering candidates who are presently authorized to work in the US for this position and who do not require visa sponsorship now or in the future. Why Join Us Our flat organizational structure promotes teamwork across the Firm and offers easy access to senior staff. While we work exceptionally well as a team in the office, our bonds are further strengthened through company events, activities and giving back. Volleyball, soccer, hockey, 5K runs, picnic, parties, and trivia nights provide friendly competition and build better relationships. By getting out of our usual environment and doing out-of-the-ordinary things together, we foster creativity and broaden our imaginations to accomplish new challenges. Benefits Highly competitive salary & bonus opportunity Generous paid time off and flexible scheduling 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits for single coverage Generous Paid Parental Leave Retirement Plans: 401K and Roth 401K Profit sharing plan Long- and short-term disability Additional Perks: Free breakfast and lunch from our in-house kitchen with rotating menus (including snacks!) On-site gym with a subsidized membership Frequent company outings Opportunity to give back to organizations that help individuals in need in the Chicagoland area Professional Development: In-house education team – classes and resources are offered for continuous learning opportunities Mentorship Program through your first six months of employment The base compensation range for this role is approximately $150,000-$200,000 contingent on experience. Wolverine Trading's total compensation model includes base salary and an annual discretionary bonus.

review_candidates.title: AVP-Digital Network Operations
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose Provide business-aware operational leadership for IT Network Operations across IOH enterprise datacenter fabric, security perimeter, enterprise WAN, and hybrid cloud integration. Drive customer excellence, 99.99%+ availability, low latency, and zero-fail service posture for enterprise production datacenters, corporate offices, and cloud interconnects. Lead continuous improvement, Cisco ACI as-Code, network automation (Ansible/Python), Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), and quality work standards while coaching team members and governing Managed Service Providers (MSPs). SCOPE OF WORK & INTEGRATED COMPETENCIES Datacenter Network: Operate Cisco ACI fabric across enterprise datacenters, spine-leaf, EVPN/VXLAN, BGP/OSPF, and SAN fabric with strict quality work standards and applied learning in automation. Network Security: Operate next-generation firewalls, F5 WAF/LTM, and SSL certificates through structured planning, risk evaluation, and close collaboration with Cyber Security. Connectivity & WAN: Manage MPLS, DIA, VPN, and SD-WAN connectivity for corporate offices, regional hubs, and remote users to deliver customer excellence. Cloud Integration: Operate Cloud Dedicated Interconnects (GCP, AWS Direct Connect, ExpressRoute) with business awareness of cloud traffic costs and VPC routing. Service Management: Lead P1/P2/P3 incident command, NPM telemetry, flow analysis, and capacity forecasting through decisive operational decision making. Vendor & MSP Governance: Direct daily MSP execution, validate vendor SLAs, review Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and coach vendor leads to build team capacity. Risk & Compliance: Manage IT network controls, ISO 27001 audit compliance, firewall rule reviews, and ZTNA micro-segmentation AUTHORITY Job: Operational approval for network changes, firewall rules, ACLs, and project handovers. People: Lead, coach, and evaluate network specialists; foster continuous learning. Budget: Input to network capex/opex budget and approve expenses within AVP limit. Requirements & Capabilities Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, IT, Telecommunications, or related field. Experience: 10+ years network engineering; 5+ years in Level 6 / AVP operational leadership. Integrated Capabilities: Decision making for P1 incidents, continuous improvement via Ansible/Python, customer excellence for SLAs, business awareness of cloud costs, change planning, quality work standards for MOPs, applied learning in ACI/ZTNA, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration. Technical Expertise: Expert in Cisco ACI, BGP/OSPF, EVPN/VXLAN, Palo Alto/Fortinet, F5 WAF/LTM, Cloud Interconnects, ITIL v4, CCNP/CCIE/PCNSE certified. TECHNICAL COMPETENCY LEVELS Datacenter Network (Cisco ACI & Fabric): Level 4 (Expert) Network Security (Firewall, WAF, Load Balancer, IPS): Level 4 (Expert) Enterprise WAN & Connectivity: Level 4 (Expert) Cloud Network Integration (Cloud Interconnect & Hybrid): Level 3 (Advanced) Network Automation & SDN (Ansible, Python, IaC): Level 3 (Advanced) ITIL & Service Operations Governance: Level 4 (Expert) Vendor & MSP Governance: Level 4 (Expert)

review_candidates.title: Marketing Field Specialist - Events & PR
review_candidates.location: Clachan Of Campsie, Scotland, United Kingdom
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Role The AI revolution is reshaping the digital landscape, and Vertiv is helping power what's next. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we bring together power, cooling, IT, and services to support the world's most demanding applications. This is marketing where it matters most, in the field, face-to-face, and directly tied to revenue. As our EMEA Field Marketing Specialist at Vertiv, a Fortune 500 company headquartered in the US with EMEA revenue doubling year over year, you'll be the engine behind event delivery, PR coordination and narrative, lead management, and brand-perfect execution across Northern Europe. You won't just plan marketing; you'll make it happen. From packed trade show floor to the precision of a perfectly routed leads to sales. You will owe the execution that turns marketing activity into measurable pipeline. You'll be the trusted day-to-day marketing partner for field sales teams, navigating complex stakeholder landscapes both face-to-face and through remote connections to ensure every activation, campaign, and touchpoint is delivered with the quality and consistency that builds real commercial momentum. Location & Working Arrangement This is a remote role; however, you will be travelling regularly (up to 3 months per year) within the UK, Ireland, and the Nordics. You will also be expected to attend face-to-face meetings at our London or Southampton offices on a regular basis. What You'll Own PR, Narrative & Communications Shape and amplify Vertiv's regional narrative through coordinated PR activity, thought leadership placement, and media engagement. Working alongside the PR Agencies and EMEA PR team to ensure consistent messaging across earned, owned, and paid channels, Coordinate content reviews and approvals with internal stakeholders to ensure accuracy, compliance, and alignment before publication, working closely with subject matter experts, portfolio teams, creating compelling content across a range of formats, including case studies, customer stories, videos, advertising, landing papers and digital campaign assets. Event Execution & Lead Conversion Run the full operational playbook for marketing events, trade shows, and field activations end-to-end. Then own the critical handoff, ensuring every lead is accurately captured, CRM-routed, qualified, and delivered to Sales with zero pipeline leakage. Go beyond attendance numbers by analysing engagement depth, lead quality, and conversion potential to prove what's actually working. Revenue PODs & Pipeline Contribution Work closely with Revenue PODs (cross-functional sales and marketing teams) to align field marketing execution with commercial targets. Ensure marketing activities directly feed into POD-level revenue goals, providing visibility on sourced and influenced pipeline at a granular, team-based level. Pipeline & Demand Generation Connect the dots between activity and impact. Track marketing-sourced pipeline contribution, monitor channel metrics, and report on the commercial value of every initiative using Power BI, Oracle Analytics, and marketing automation platforms. Brand, Content & Communications Enforce global guidelines across all outputs, agency-produced, partner-generated, or internal — while ensuring every piece of messaging aligns with the broader GTM strategy and commercial objectives. Develop compelling customer case studies with Sales and manage local social media that balances global consistency with local relevance. Multi-Stakeholder Interface & Sales Alignment Serve as the go-to marketing contact for field sales teams, channel partners, regional leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders — building trusted relationships through regular face-to-face engagement at our London or Southampton offices and effective remote collaboration across time zones. Align on priorities, event participation, and campaign execution. Brief agencies with clarity and hold the line on timelines and quality. Strengthening Vertiv's presence in the local industry ecosystem through meaningful community engagement and connections. AI-Powered Efficiency & Innovation The Specialist is expected to leverage the latest AI-powered content creation, research, productivity, and workflow automation tools to improve efficiency, enhance content quality, and support content strategy execution. Staying ahead of emerging technologies and integrating them into day-to-day marketing operations is a core expectation of this role. Data Governance & Accountability Ensure all data handling, lead capture, and communications comply with privacy regulations. Track KPIs consistently, maintain data accuracy, and share performance openly, reinforcing a culture of transparency and continuous improvement. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or related field 3+ years of professional experience in field marketing, including content, communications, technical writing, engineering, IT, data center, or related technical fields. Demonstrated experience managing event logistics and post-event lead processes. Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Oracle, Redwood) and marketing automation platforms (e.g., 6Sense, PowerBi, social media scheduling tools, budgeting & expense platforms) Experience using Canva Pro Excellent written and verbal English Willingness to travel regularly within the UK, Ireland, and the Nordics (up to 3 months per year) and attend face-to-face meetings at our London or Southampton office on a regular basis. Desired Profile Strong interest in and understanding technology and digital infrastructure markets. Ability to quickly learn and communicate complex technical subjects. Ability to manage multiple projects and navigate structured review and approval processes. Experience in B2B technology marketing, engineering, IT, data center, or related industries preferred. Familiarity of working for large US corporates Proven PR experience and event management skills. Skills & Competencies End-to-end event delivery and logistics management Lead management mastery, CRM routing, qualification, and follow-up frameworks. Proven ability to interface with multiple stakeholders at all levels, both face-to-face and via remote/virtual channels Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and managing multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience working within or alongside Revenue PODs or cross-functional commercial teams. PR coordination and narrative development for regional media and industry audiences Brand enforcement with a keen eye for visual and messaging consistency Social media content development and performance monitoring across B2B platforms Clear, compelling copywriting for case studies, sales enablement, and event collateral Cross-functional collaboration with sales teams, agencies, and internal stakeholders Marketing analytics and pipeline reporting Proficiency in leveraging AI-powered content creation, research, productivity, and workflow automation tools to improve efficiency and enhance output quality. Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. About Us The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion. OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES High-Performance Culture Customer Focus Operational Excellence Innovation Financial Strength VERTIV BEHAVIORS Own it Act with urgency Foster a customer-first mindset Think big and execute Lead by example Drive continuous improvement Learn and seek out development Promote transparent & open communication About Vertiv Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. review_candidates.title: Devops Engineer SR
review_candidates.description: Why you'll LOVE Sagent: You could work anywhere. We know you are talented and looking for something inspiring and impactful. A place where you will make a difference and have a great time doing it! By choosing Sagent, you can be part of our mission to make loans and homeownership simpler and safer for all consumers. Sagent powers servicers and consumers. You power Sagent! Cloud Infrastructure Engineer SR About The Role The Cloud Engineering team builds the foundation that every engineering team at Sagent runs on. We design and deliver internal platforms and products that make shipping to production fast, secure, and repeatable. Our team builds and operates shared infrastructure capabilities including a self-service Internal Developer Portal, a centralized CI/CD platform, reusable infrastructure modules, and policy-as-code enforcement that enables teams to move quickly without sacrificing safety. We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support both infrastructure and application development teams working on a large-scale, event-driven microservices platform running on GKE. This role bridges platform engineering and application support: you will maintain and evolve Azure/GCP and Kubernetes infrastructure while partnering directly with development teams to unblock delivery, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve the paved road from code to production. What You’ll Do Operate and improve multi-region GKE clusters hosting hundreds of microservices across multiple environments from development through production Manage the Kubernetes platform layer: Istio service mesh, cert-manager, external-dns, RBAC, HPA/KEDA autoscaling, HashiCorp Vault secret injection, and Helm-based deployments Develop and maintain Terraform modules across multiple IaC repositories covering GKE, networking (Shared VPC, Cloud NAT, Private Service Connect), Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Cloud Composer, Vault, and web hosting Maintain and extend Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines using shared Terraform templates with multi-environment deployment workflows Support Confluent Kafka infrastructure including Connect workers with JDBC source connectors, consumer group health monitoring, and Kafka-lag-based autoscaling with KEDA Manage Redis Enterprise clusters on Kubernetes with operator-managed lifecycle and replication Operate the observability stack: Grafana Cloud (Alloy, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope via Private Service Connect), kube-prometheus-stack, Google Managed Prometheus, OpenTelemetry Operator/Collector, Beyla, and Kubecost Harden cluster security posture: NetworkPolicies, Pod Security Standards, admission policy enforcement, CrowdStrike Falcon, Lacework, kube-bench, and cert-manager with Let’s Encrypt ACME Support data infrastructure including Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), Dataproc (Spark), Cloud Composer (Airflow), Matillion CDC pipelines, Snowflake, and BigQuery Manage DNS across multiple providers (Azure DNS, Cloudflare, GCP Cloud DNS) via external-dns, and support Azure APIM and Cloudflare CDN/WAF Partner directly with application development teams to troubleshoot deployment failures, tune resource limits and autoscaling, and resolve Kafka consumer lag and connectivity issues Contribute to the Internal Developer Portal (Backstage) and internal CLI tooling that enables self-service for product engineers What We’re Looking For 7+ years of cloud or infrastructure engineering experience Strong production experience with GKE, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and Artifact Registry Advanced Terraform experience, including reusable module design, state management, and multi-environment patterns Production Kubernetes expertise: Helm chart development and management, RBAC, resource tuning, and troubleshooting workloads at scale Hands-on experience with Istio service mesh: sidecar injection, mTLS, VirtualServices, AuthorizationPolicies, and traffic management Understanding of CNI fundamentals (Cilium/Dataplane V2), east-west traffic flows, and network segmentation Experience with CI/CD pipeline development (Azure DevOps YAML pipelines or equivalent) and trunk-based development workflows Hands-on experience with secrets management, including HashiCorp Vault (Kubernetes auth, agent injection) and GCP Secret Manager Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python, or Go) with the ability to write production-quality automation and tooling Strong security mindset with experience implementing least-privilege IAM, certificate management, and policy-driven controls Clear and effective communicator able to work across infrastructure and application development teams Nice to Have Experience with event-driven architectures and Apache Kafka (Confluent Platform, Connect, consumer group management, KEDA-based scaling) Experience with Redis Enterprise on Kubernetes (operator-managed clusters, Active-Active replication) Familiarity with Grafana Cloud observability stack (Alloy, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope) and OpenTelemetry Experience with GCP data services: Dataproc (Spark), Cloud Composer (Airflow), BigQuery, Pub/Sub Familiarity with OPA/Rego or Kyverno for policy enforcement Experience with Azure APIM, Cloudflare, or multi-cloud DNS management Familiarity with Matillion or similar ETL/CDC tooling and Snowflake data warehouse Exposure to financial services or mortgage/loan servicing domain and associated compliance requirements Experience with Kubecost or similar FinOps tooling for cloud cost optimization Experience building or contributing to an Internal Developer Portal (Backstage) Who You Are You are someone who thrives at the intersection of infrastructure and application support. You understand that a platform is only as good as the experience it provides to the teams building on it, and you are energized by helping development teams ship reliably and quickly. You hold a high bar for reliability, security, and operational hygiene — you proactively identify and resolve issues before they become incidents. You are comfortable operating at scale in a complex microservices environment and can context-switch between Terraform modules, Kubernetes troubleshooting, Kafka consumer lag, and pipeline failures. You value automation, documentation, and simplicity. You are pragmatic about technical debt and know when to fix it versus when to ship. You are comfortable working on a team of senior engineers, contributing your perspective, and adjusting quickly as you gain new information. Perks! As a Sagent Associate, you will be eligible to participate in our benefit programs beginning on Day #1! We offer a comprehensive package including Remote/Hybrid workplace options, Health Benefits, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, Family Planning Services, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Family Leave, 401(k) Matching, Pet Insurance, In-person and Virtual Social Experiences, Career Pathing, Focus Time Fridays and much, much more! Why Sagent? Sagent is transforming the mortgage servicing industry by bringing the modern experience customers now expect from loan originations to loan servicing. Our platform lets customers manage their home-owing lives from anywhere while giving servicers lower costs, scale compliance and higher servicing values through full market cycles. Sagent is a joint venture that combines Fiserv Inc.'s decades of market-leading fintech expertise with Warburg Pincus' skill in growing technology companies. We hire innovators and doers to disrupt the last and most complex frontier of lending and housing. We're growing fast and need you to help shape our future. Sagent is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

review_candidates.title: CAPACITY OFFICER (H/F/X)
review_candidates.description: Titre de la fonction CAPACITY OFFICER (H/F/X) Type de contrat CDI Régime de travail Temps plein TRAVAILLER CHEZ SIBELGA, ÇA BOOSTE MON ÉNERGIE ! Sibelga est le gestionnaire du réseau de distribution d'électricité et de gaz naturel dans la Région de Bruxelles-Capitale. Nous assurons un approvisionnement énergétique fiable et durable à nos clients. Nous visons l'innovation et l'efficacité dans nos services. QUEL SERVICE REJOIGNEZ-VOUS ? Digital Business Solutions (DBS), le département informatique de Sibelga, soutient l’ensemble des activités « métier » de Sibelga. DBS veille à ce qu’elles se déroulent efficacement et puissent se développer, en dotant Sibelga d’un système informatique autonome, évolutif et aligné sur les besoins métiers et les avancées technologiques. Cela est réalisé grâce au développement et à la mise en œuvre d’une stratégie IT centrée sur cinq priorités : Data & IA, Expérience Utilisateur, Cloud & Infrastructure, Sécurité & Résilience et Gestion des Processus & du Cycle de Vie. De cette manière, le département DBS contribue de manière significative aux objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques de Sibelga. Au sein du département DBS, IT Infrastructure est responsable de la conception, de l’implémentation, de la gestion et de l’optimisation de l’ensemble des fondations technologiques IT, telles que les réseaux, les serveurs, le stockage et les solutions cloud. L’équipe garantit la sécurité, la disponibilité et la continuité des systèmes, et réalise les activités de monitoring, de résolution de problèmes et de reprise d’activité en cas d’incident. Elle soutient également les projets, les initiatives d’optimisation et la collaboration avec les autres équipes IT afin de fournir des services stables, performants et efficaces. VOTRE JOB Nous recherchons un IT Capacity Officer capable de gérer de manière proactive les capacités, les inventaires, les licences, les contrats et les ressources datacenter afin de garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la continuité de nos infrastructures IT. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans le dimensionnement, la conformité et l’optimisation de l’environnement technique, en veillant à ce qu’il réponde aux besoins actuels et futurs de l’entreprise. Ce poste polyvalent exige une combinaison de compétences techniques, analytiques et organisationnelles, ainsi qu’une capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Votre rôle s’articule autour de quatre volets principaux , chacun contribuant à la stabilité et à l’évolution de nos infrastructures : Dans le cadre du Datacenter & Infrastructure (10%), vous supervisez la gestion quotidienne des salles informatiques opérées par nos partenaires, coordonnez les activités d’entretien et de maintenance, évaluez les besoins physiques en énergie, refroidissement et capacité de rack, et assurez le suivi des installations, modifications et retraits de matériel. Le volet Capacity & Asset Management (50%) constitue le cœur de votre mission. Vous gérez le cycle de vie complet du hardware et du software, organisez le retrait, la réallocation ou la revente des équipements, et maintenez un inventaire IT fiable tout en alimentant la CMDB. Vous optimisez l’utilisation des assets, gérez les stocks, préparez les budgets CAPEX/OPEX liés aux équipements et anticipez les besoins d’évolution des infrastructures sur 1 à 4 ans en collaboration avec l’équipe Architecture. Vous veillez également à l’application des standards d’équipement et du catalogue IT. Dans le cadre du Licence Management (20%), vous assurez la gestion des licences Microsoft (subscriptions et OnPrem), ainsi que celles d’Oracle, VMware, Apple et autres éditeurs. Vous suivez les acquisitions, renouvellements et retraits, et vérifiez la conformité des demandes et des usages. Enfin, pour le volet Contract Management (20%), vous gérez les renouvellements de contrats de support et maintenance, suivez les engagements contractuels et les coûts associés, participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges pour les nouveaux marchés et veillez à l’application des exigences techniques ainsi qu’au respect des SLAs par les fournisseurs. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master en sciences informatiques, en sciences commerciales avec orientation IT, ou d’un diplôme équivalent par expérience. Vous disposez d’une expérience probante en infrastructures IT, en gestion de capacité, en gestion d’actifs, ainsi qu’en gestion des contrats fournisseurs et des licences logicielles. Vous maîtrisez les environnements datacenter, les processus ITIL, la gestion d’inventaire et de CMDB, ainsi que les modèles de licences Microsoft, Oracle, VMware ou Apple. Vous êtes également à l’aise avec la préparation et le suivi des budgets CAPEX/OPEX et possédez une bonne compréhension des systèmes d’information (virtualisation, stockage, bases de données, systèmes Windows). Sur le plan humain, vous faites preuve de rigueur, de méthode et d’un excellent sens de l’organisation. Vous êtes assertif, capable de négocier et de coordonner efficacement avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes. Votre sens de l’anticipation, votre capacité d’analyse et votre orientation optimisation vous permettent de prendre des décisions éclairées. Autonome, responsable et doté d’une communication claire, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et adoptez une attitude conviviale et professionnelle. NOTRE OFFRE Une entreprise certifiée Top Employer, valorisant le bien-être et le développement de ses collaborateurs. Un job porteur de sens, au service de la ville de Bruxelles et de ses habitants, dans un secteur d’activité en perpétuelle évolution. Une formation de qualité et valorisante, ainsi que des perspectives de carrière. Un package salarial attractif comprenant : Une indemnité de représentation, une prime de fin d’année et un double pécule de vacances, des chèques-repas (10 €/jour presté), des écochèques, un bonus individuel et un bonus collectif. 20 jours de congés légaux et 13 jours de récupération. Une assurance hospitalisation et soins ambulatoires pour le ménage, ainsi qu’une assurance groupe et une assurance accidents vie privée. Une voiture de leasing ou un budget mobilité. Une réduction de 30 % sur votre facture d’énergie. Un smartphone avec abonnement (également à usage privé), un ordinateur portable et le remboursement d’internet. Un fonds social (intervention dans les frais de lunettes, prothèses dentaires et autres frais médicaux, chèque Saint-Nicolas et Noël, etc.).

review_candidates.title: AI Infrastructure & Platform Operations Engineer (remote in the EU)
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at www.mirantis.com. review_candidates.title: (Senior) Engineer, Payload Network & Timing, meoSphere
review_candidates.description: Requisition Number: 19751 Contract Type: Permanent Location(s): Long Beach, CA, US Betzdorf, LU (Senior) Engineer, Payload Network & Timing, meoSphere Programme Description meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones. To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility. Role Description Summary This role sits at the heart of a fully digital, software‑defined satellite payload . You will architect the network fabric and timing backbone that makes regenerative processing, beamforming, and inter‑satellite routing behave as a single coherent machine —with deterministic performance, timing discipline, and zero tolerance for ambiguity. If you enjoy designing systems where physics, networking, and real‑time behaviour collide , this role gives you direct ownership of one of the hardest problems in modern space payloads. Key Responsibilities The payload timing architecture end‑to‑end: You define and own PTP (IEEE 1588v2) and SyncE across distributed on‑board nodes, including master/slave hierarchies, clock discipline, and holdover behaviour. The payload works—or fails—based on your decisions. The internal payload network fabric: You architect the L2/L3 switching and routing logic that moves traffic deterministically between On‑Board Processing, Digital Beamforming, Service Links, Feeder Links, and Optical Inter‑Satellite Links. Deterministic performance under real load: You design QoS classes and shaping policies, then validate them under congestion. Jitter, wander, latency, and packet loss are not abstract metrics—they are first‑class design constraints. Technical leadership by design authority: You are the payload’s reference for networking and timing. You drive architecture trade‑offs, own interface definitions, and make decisions that scale from lab bring‑up to flight hardware. Competencies, Qualifications & Experience Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. Strong experience designing and owning timing‑critical and/or high‑performance networked systems, with direct responsibility for correctness, stability, and runtime behaviour. Deep hands‑on expertise with precision time and synchronization technologies, including IEEE 1588v2 (PTP) and SyncE, and a solid understanding of clock hierarchy, discipline, and holdover behaviour. Proven ability to architect and reason about L2/L3 networks in complex systems, including routing, switching, VLANs, multicast, and deterministic traffic behaviour. Experience designing and validating QoS and traffic shaping mechanisms under congestion and stress conditions. Practical exposure to high‑throughput data‑plane processing, such as DPDK, XDP, or equivalent high‑speed packet processing frameworks. Strong system‑level mindset: able to translate requirements into clean architectures, make sound trade‑offs, and document interfaces clearly. Comfortable acting as a technical authority in a focused domain, driving decisions and aligning other engineers around a coherent design. Nice to have Experience working on distributed, real‑time, or hardware‑adjacent systems where latency, jitter, and determinism are first‑order constraints. Hands‑on use of traffic generation and analysis tools (e.g., Spirent, Ixia) and familiarity with jitter / wander characterization. Background in space, aerospace, telecom, or other safety‑critical or mission‑critical environments where systems must work exactly as designed. Track record of simplifying complex systems without hiding risk or deferring hard problems. What success looks like The payload maintains tight frequency and phase alignment across distributed nodes—even through mode changes and degraded conditions. Traffic flows are predictable, deterministic, and debuggable under peak load. The network architecture scales cleanly across payload functions without timing hacks or hidden coupling. Other engineers trust your designs because they are simple where possible, precise where required. Other Key Requirements Eligibility for ESA/EU/NATO/National SECRET personnel security clearances. Candidates must be prepared to undergo a security clearance procedure, as this position may require holding such clearance, is considered an asset. review_candidates.title: Senior-менеджер із міжнародних закупівель та ЗЕД
review_candidates.description: Senior-менеджер із міжнародних закупівель та ЗЕД Avelon Group — українська компанія у сфері зовнішньоекономічної діяльності. Ми розвиваємо комплексне постачання будівельних матеріалів, обладнання та комплектуючих від іноземних виробників для корпоративних клієнтів в Україні. Шукаємо досвідченого спеціаліста, який зможе самостійно організувати повний цикл міжнародної закупівлі: від пошуку та перевірки виробника до доставки й митного оформлення товару в Україні. Нам потрібен не координатор, який лише передає інформацію між учасниками процесу, а сильний фахівець, здатний вести переговори, знижувати закупівельну вартість, оцінювати ризики та відповідати за результат закупівлі. Основні завдання Робота з постачальниками: • пошук виробників і постачальників у Китаї, Туреччині, країнах Європи та на інших ринках; • перевірка надійності постачальників і виробничих можливостей підприємств; • отримання та порівняння комерційних пропозицій; • проведення переговорів щодо ціни, мінімального замовлення, строків виробництва, гарантій та умов оплати; • замовлення зразків і організація перевірки якості продукції; • формування та розвиток бази перевірених постачальників; • пошук альтернативних виробників для зниження ризиків і закупівельної вартості. Організація закупівель: • розрахунок повної собівартості товару до складу в Україні; • підготовка та перевірка контрактів, специфікацій, інвойсів і пакувальних листів; • узгодження технічних характеристик, кількості та строків постачання; • контроль виробництва і готовності замовлення; • організація передвідвантажувальної інспекції; • контроль оплат, відвантажень і виконання постачальниками договірних зобов’язань; • робота з рекламаціями та врегулювання питань щодо якості або недопоставки. ЗЕД і міжнародна логістика: • підготовка комплекту документів для міжнародного перевезення та митного оформлення; • робота з умовами Incoterms; • взаємодія з перевізниками, експедиторами, митними брокерами, лабораторіями та сертифікаційними органами; • контроль строків і вартості доставки; • перевірка необхідності сертифікації, дозвільних документів та обмежень щодо імпорту; • контроль правильності документів до моменту відвантаження; • ведення реєстру закупівель, платежів, строків виробництва та доставки. Взаємодія з відділом продажів: • отримання та опрацювання запитів на закупівлю; • пошук товарів відповідно до потреб корпоративних клієнтів; • підготовка закупівельної частини комерційної пропозиції; • надання відділу продажів інформації про ціни, строки, характеристики та ризики постачання; • участь у формуванні нових товарних напрямів компанії. Вимоги до кандидата • успішний досвід у міжнародних закупівлях та ЗЕД від 3 років; • практичний досвід закупівель у Китаї та інших країнах; • знання повного циклу імпорту товарів в Україну; • досвід самостійних переговорів з іноземними виробниками; • практичне знання Incoterms, міжнародних контрактів і платіжних умов; • уміння розраховувати повну собівартість імпортної операції; • розуміння міжнародної логістики та митного оформлення; • англійська мова не нижче рівня B2; • упевнене володіння Excel або Google Sheets; • уважність до документів, аналітичне мислення та відповідальність; • здатність самостійно організовувати роботу та дотримуватися строків. Буде значною перевагою: • досвід закупівель будівельних матеріалів, обладнання або технічних товарів; • наявність власної бази перевірених виробників і логістичних партнерів; • досвід проведення аудиту або інспекції виробництва; • знання китайської або турецької мови; • досвід роботи з сертифікацією та товарами, що потребують додаткового контролю. Ми пропонуємо • фіксовану заробітну плату 80 000 грн на місяць; • квартальний KPI-бонус до 80 000 грн; • прозорі показники для розрахунку бонусу: економія закупівельної вартості, дотримання строків, якість документів і відсутність обґрунтованих рекламацій; • віддалений формат роботи; • повну зайнятість; • пряме спілкування з власником компанії та швидке погодження рішень; • можливість самостійно формувати систему міжнародних закупівель; • доступ до аналітичних платформ та інструментів пошуку постачальників; • можливість брати участь у розвитку нових товарних напрямів; • перспективу очолити напрям міжнародних закупівель та ЗЕД. Конфіденційність Ми конфіденційно розглядаємо кандидатів, які зараз працюють і готові обговорити нову професійну можливість. Ми не очікуємо передачі комерційних таємниць або конфіденційних документів попереднього роботодавця. Нас цікавлять ваш досвід, професійні навички, репутація та здатність побудувати ефективну систему закупівель. Як подати заявку Надішліть резюме та коротко зазначте: • з якими країнами та категоріями товарів ви працювали; • які закупівлі вели самостійно; • який найбільший контракт або партію супроводжували; • якими мовами володієте; • якого результату досягли у зниженні ціни, строків або ризиків постачання.

review_candidates.description: Requisition Number: 19932 Contract Type: Permanent Location(s): Munich (Unterföhring), DE Betzdorf, LU Programme Description IRIS2 is the new European Union secure satellite constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States. In addition, as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while benefiting from ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones. SES – together with other consortium partners and core members - was selected by the European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS2 multi-orbit satellite constellation. The IRIS2 team enters next project phases, we seek and there is a strong need of support for all the activities around service provisioning and products that the system can offer in the future. Role Description Summary The IVV Technical Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and technical oversight of Integration, Verification, and Validation (IVV) activities for satellite systems. The role ensures that spacecraft, payload, and ground interface requirements are fully verified and validated against customer, regulatory, and mission requirements. Acting as the bridge between systems engineering, AIT, product assurance, and programme management, the IVV Technical Project Manager ensures robust verification coverage, schedule adherence, risk control, and technical compliance throughout the satellite lifecycle—from design to launch readiness. Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas IVV Planning & Management Define, maintain, and control the IVV strategy, ensuring full traceability to system and mission requirements. Develop and manage IVV plans, verification control documents (VCD), and test matrices. Plan and monitor IVV schedules, milestones, and resource allocation in alignment with programme objectives. Coordinate internal and external IVV activities across payload, platform, and system levels. Technical Coordination Interface with Systems Engineering to ensure clear, verifiable, and testable requirements. Coordinate verification activities across: Equipment level Subsystem level Spacecraft system level Ensure alignment between IVV approach and AIT flow (functional, environmental, and operational validation). Test & Verification Oversight Plan and support integration and verification campaigns including: Functional testing Environmental testing (TV, TB, vibro acoustic, EMC) End to end system validation Prepare and lead Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Qualification Reviews (QR), and Acceptance Reviews (AR). Oversee verification evidence generation, data review, and compliance closure. Stakeholder & Interface Management Act as the focal point for IVV related coordination with: Engineering teams AIT teams and test facilities Product Assurance / Quality External suppliers and partners Customers and space agencies Support programme reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) from an IVV perspective. Risk, Quality & Compliance Identify IVV related technical, schedule, and resource risks; implement mitigation actions. Manage non conformances, deviations, and waivers related to IVV activities. Ensure compliance with applicable standards (ECSS, ESA, NASA, company processes). Support anomaly investigations and lessons learned initiatives. COMPETENCIES Strong understanding of the satellite lifecycle and system architecture. Solid knowledge of IVV methodologies, verification logic, and test philosophies. Ability to analyse requirements and define appropriate verification approaches (test, analysis, inspection, demonstration). Excellent planning, organisational, and stakeholder coordination skills. Strong communication and documentation abilities. Structured, detail oriented, and quality driven mindset. Qualifications & Experience Master's degree in aerospace engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent. 5+ years of experience in IVV, AIT, or System Engineering within space or complex system projects. Fluency in English, both written and spoken Any other European Language is considered an asset Proven experience in verification planning and execution for satellite or high reliability systems. Experience working in a multidisciplinary and matrix organisation. Experience with ESA or institutional programmes. Knowledge of ECSS standards and product assurance processes. Experience with payload or platform subsystems verification. Familiarity with requirements management tools and IVV tracking tools. Project management certification (PMP®, PRINCE2, IPMA). People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. new_matches.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role The IT and AI Enablement function exists to make Legora itself run as well as the product we sell: secure, automated, and compounding over time. The Workplace Network Engineer owns the network and connectivity estate across every Legora location — the Meraki and Tailscale footprint, from wired and wireless to WAN and the zero-trust mesh — accountable for keeping every site fast, secure, and connected. You set the network standards the whole company is built to, and the Workplace Technology Leads at each site are your hands for installs and upgrades. What You'll Be Doing Own the reference design every site is rolled out from — LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN / SD-WAN, segmentation (VLANs), DNS / DHCP, and firewall policy — so each new office comes up the same proven way. Run the Meraki Dashboard as the single source of truth — configuration templates, firmware lifecycle, licensing and inventory, alerting, and capacity planning across all sites. Operate the Tailscale zero-trust mesh — ACLs, device posture, and access routing — alongside Information Security, who owns identity and the access policy itself. Monitor connectivity proactively and own uptime: catch degradation before users feel it, drive incidents to resolution, run root-cause analysis, and keep mean-time-to-recover falling. Plan and program-manage network installs and upgrades for new-site buildouts and refreshes — scope the design, order and stage hardware, and direct the on-site Workplace Technology Leads and cabling / ISP vendors who do the physical work, holding them to Legora’s acceptance tests. Manage ISP, circuit, and connectivity-vendor relationships — procurement, contracts, SLAs, and escalations — and forecast network spend with Finance. Partner with the IT Systems and Helpdesk teams on Tier-2 / Tier-3 network escalations, and document the estate so it stays legible to the rest of the function. Who You Are 6+ years in network engineering or network-focused IT infrastructure, including owning a multi-site corporate network end to end as the final escalation point — with no senior network engineer above you to hand it to. For the Staff end of the band, ~10+ years and a track record of defining network architecture across a multi-site organization. Deep Cisco Meraki experience at multi-site scale — and you understand what the Dashboard abstracts away. You can design and reason about the routing, segmentation, and RF beneath it, and keep the network running when the abstraction leaks. Fluency with the GUI is assumed, not the job. Vendor-agnostic command of network fundamentals — you design from first principles, not from templates: L2 / L3 boundaries, IP addressing and subnetting (IPAM), routing including BGP with ISPs, dual-circuit / SD-WAN failover, VLAN segmentation, DNS / DHCP, QoS, and firewall policy — and you troubleshoot at the packet level (e.g. Wireshark) when the dashboard isn’t enough. Able to walk us through a multi-site network you designed end to end — the trade-offs you made, a failure mode you engineered out, and a cutover or migration you ran without taking the business down. A standards-setter — you’d rather define one blueprint every site copies than improvise each office, and you keep the next buildout cleaner than the last. Automation-minded — you reach for the Meraki API, Pulumi or Terraform, and scripting to manage the network as code, rather than clicking through dashboards by hand. A calm operator under pressure — when a site drops, you’re methodical, communicative, and relentless about root cause, not just the quick fix. A program manager who delivers through others — comfortable owning timelines, vendors, and a budget, and getting work done through on-site teams you don’t directly manage. Nice To Have Cisco depth at CCNP / CCIE level — certified or demonstrably equivalent. CCNA alone is below the bar for this role; Meraki CMNA / ECMS a plus. Production experience operating Tailscale or comparable zero-trust network access (ZTNA), and certificate / mTLS fundamentals. Office buildouts and structured / low-voltage cabling — commissioning networked building systems and coordinating installers. Physical-security and AV networking — getting cameras / access-control (e.g. Verkada) and conferencing (Neat, Zoom) onto the network and keeping them available. Comfortable running work through an ITSM / service-desk platform and adopting AI-assisted, agentic automation — we run an AI-native ITSM (Serval). Connectivity and SaaS-reachability monitoring across sites — synthetic / path monitoring (e.g. ThousandEyes, Catchpoint), a multi-site NMS (e.g. Auvik, PRTG, or Datadog), and SNMP / syslog telemetry, on top of Meraki’s native alerting. Wi-Fi design and validation tooling — RF surveys and heat-mapping (e.g. Ekahau or Hamina). Experience with Meraki, Tailscale, Neat, Zoom, Verkada, Okta, and 1Password. Please note that due to summer holidays, our response times may be a little longer than usual. We'll be reviewing applications from late July/early August. Thank you for your patience! What’s In It For You Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America. Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success. Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily. In-person environment: Union Square office designed for ambitious builders and company provided lunch daily. Benefits & Perks: We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: Medical, Dental & Vision Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection) Dental plans via MetLife Vision plans via Vision Care Family Support Generous parental leave Free access to Maven Clinic Dependent Care FSA Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents Additional Perks Pre-tax commuter benefits Life Insurance + STD/LTD 401(K) with generous company match Unlimited PTO Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Compensation Range: $215K - $254K
